Melchizedek_1: King of Salem, a priest of God Most High (Genesis 14:18)
Levi_1: third-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:34), son of Leah
Judah_1: fourth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:35), son of Leah
Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
Aaron_1: brother of Moses (Exodus 4:14) and Levitical priest (Exodus 28:1)
